chance_method: chance_p95_abs: asset-side values block-shuffled against the odds inside each family's own date window, circular blocks of max(20, 4 x lag) = 20 trading days for every row, 1000 shuffles, Spearman, 95th percentile of the absolute shuffled correlation. Size rows use moves divided by their median over the previous 60 trading days (odds size: previous 60 values), past data only. 60-day blocks (300 shuffles) are a reported check only. Strongest picks: ranked by |spearman| / shuffle spread; pick_chance_p95 = 95th percentile, over shuffle rounds, of the largest |spearman| among the picked_from_n candidates.
label: description only, not proven
no_pick_beats_chance_text: 2 of 21 strongest picks pass the strict pick-from-many check.

hold_back.note: odds values used only up to each family boundary; later data is kept clean for future formal tests

chance_summary.definition: 'strong' means passing the chance line: |spearman| above chance_p95_abs, the 95th percentile of |spearman| over block-shuffled dates for that same row (blocks of max(20, 4 x lag) trading days). chance_summary.pairs_tested_note: pairs_tested counts family-and-asset groups (event family, odds measure, asset); each group has 5 timings, so rows_tested = 540 rows.
chance_summary.all_rows_note: rows_tested, expected_strong_by_luck, observed_strong, bh_flagged_at_5_percent and observed_strong_60d_check cover all 540 tested rows, including the 23 rows with fewer than 10 independent episodes that are not shown in pairs[]. The *_shown fields cover only the 517 rows in pairs[].
